operator: Bush and Beyond Ltd (booking agent) / Jackson Looseyia & Dominic Nchoe
region: Western boundary of the Masai Mara Reserve (Musiara airstrip)

rates.unit: per person per night sharing, no single supplement in regular season (excl. Mara Reserve fees, added separately)

capacity: 6 ensuite tents + 1 family tent (2 ensuite bedrooms, shared sitting area)

childPolicy.note: Not recommended for children under 5 years.

inclusions: Full board, soft drinks/local beers/non-premium wines/spirits, Musiara airstrip transfers, statutory taxes, laundry, unlimited shared game drives (Mara Reserve + Mara Triangle), bush breakfasts/lunches, Maasai village visit, guided walks, sundowners.
exclusions: Maasai Mara National Reserve fees, Jackson Looseiya private guide ($600/day, min 3 days), exclusive vehicle ($300/day), champagne/premium spirits.
notes: Open year-round. Departures after 11am from Musiara attract an extra day's reserve fee (free 2-hour transit ticket before 11am on departure day).
